summary: Seer, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing its Board’s unanimous rejection of a revised unsolicited, non-binding acquisition proposal from Bradley L. Radoff, Michael Torok, and affiliates (Radoff-JEC Group) on April 24, 2026. The proposal, at $2.35 per share in cash plus a contingent value right, was deemed to significantly undervalue the company given its growth potential in the proteomics market. The Board, advised by independent financial and legal advisors, determined the offer was not in shareholders’ best interests. No advisor names were disclosed. The rejection suggests ongoing defense; watch for potential proxy fight, hostile tender, or increased bid from the Radoff-JEC Group as risk-arb uncertainty remains high.
